scope: Bounded no-execution and hostile-input regressions for the local scanner and CLI; not an independent security certification, compatibility accuracy measurement or M1 acceptance.
command: pnpm build && pnpm vitest run tests/scan.test.ts

probes.name: manifest lifecycle scripts are inert
probes.test: never executes malicious manifest lifecycle scripts in core or CLI scans
probes.expected: No marker file is created by a core scan or CLI scan; both return explicit unknown inventory findings.

probes.name: special file is skipped
probes.test: skips a FIFO special file without opening it
probes.expected: The FIFO is not opened and the report records special-file-skipped.

probes.name: aggregate input limit
probes.test: fails when the aggregate 32 MiB input limit is exhausted
probes.expected: A scan exceeding 32 MiB aborts instead of returning a partial report.

probes.name: directory depth limit
probes.test: fails at the 64-level directory depth boundary
probes.expected: A directory below the 64-level boundary aborts with the documented depth-limit diagnostic.

probes.name: corrupt lockfile diagnostic
probes.test: rejects a corrupt lockfile through the CLI without leaking paths or contents
probes.expected: CLI exits 1, leaves stdout empty, names the lockfile and exposes neither the absolute root nor source contents.

limits: The probe is authored regression evidence and does not establish independent security certification.
Concurrent hostile directory replacement remains outside this local scanner isolation model.
This does not establish dependency/API accuracy, runtime compatibility, formal M1 acceptance or release readiness.
